Package org.clafer.alloy

package org.clafer.alloy
This package provides the Alloy 6 code of a temporal model, as clafer -m alloy writes it: a port of the Clafer compiler's AlloyLtl generator, with the mapping of the positions in the Alloy code back to the model's constraints.
  • Related Packages
    Package
    Description
    org.clafer.alloy.solve
    This package provides the Alloy backend of the solution loop, for temporal models: a port of claferIG that runs Alloy 6.2.0 in the same JVM, finds the traces of a model, reads them from Alloy's XML, and computes unsat cores and their near-misses.
  • Class
    Description
    AlloyGenerator
    The Alloy 6 code of a temporal model, as clafer -m alloy writes it (P.als): the port of the compiler's Generator/AlloyLtl.hs (AlloyLtl) on the input the compiler builds for it (AlloyInput).
    AlloyGenerator.Assertion
    An assertion of the model, with its name in the Alloy code.
    AlloyGenerator.Kind
    What the code of a region of the Alloy code is: a constraint of the model, or a cardinality of a clafer (not a group cardinality).
    AlloyGenerator.Mapped
    A region of the Alloy code (1-based lines and columns, as mapLineCol gives them) and what it is the code of.
    AlloyGenerator.Translation
    The Alloy code of a model for solving it, as claferIG has the compiler write it, and what claferIG reads from the compiler with it.
    AlloyGenerator.UnsupportedModel
    A model that the port does not translate.
